records.name: ESP32-S31-Touch-LCD-4.3C
records.launch: Exact hardware launch date unknown. Manufacturer documentation names factory firmware dated 2026-10-30.
records.revision: ESP32-S31-WROOM-3-N16R16 version, bare board SKU 36107. PCB revision not identified.
records.scope: The rear-view board drawing maps the 16-position H4 terminal to power, I2C, CAN, RS485 and GPIO48 through GPIO53. The manufacturer also lists H4 and J3 pin numbers. GPIO48 through GPIO53 use native 3.3 V logic. The S3 version has different connections.
